name: CR_v3.0
summary_en: Global terrestrial evapotranspiration estimated by the calibration-free complementary relationship model (Version 3.0). Forcing includes air temperature and relative humidity from JRA3Q, and net radiation and wind speed from ERA5, with net radiation corrected against CERES. V3 is an upgraded version of V2; earlier versions are deprecated.
summary_zh: 由无需率定的互补关系模型估算的全球陆地蒸散发产品（第 3 版）。驱动数据为 JRA3Q 的气温和相对湿度，以及 ERA5 的净辐射和风速，其中净辐射已对照 CERES 订正。V3 为 V2 的升级版，早期版本不再推荐使用。
